slides.title: Six owners, one wooden pole
slides.sub: Pole attachments and joint use, explained

slides.title: The agreement usually sets your schedule.
slides.body: Not the cable and not the crew. The pole attachment process.

slides.title: Owners and attachers
slides.body: The electric utility or telco owns the pole. Everyone else attaches under an agreement with rules and annual rent.

slides.title: Who regulates it in the US
slides.body: Section 224 gives the FCC authority, but many states regulate themselves. Co-op and municipal poles are exempt.

slides.title: Costly mistakes
slides.body: Attaching to poles never applied for. Cables at the wrong height. Old cable left on the pole and still billed.
